current_match_summary.description: Read one current match summary by exact tournament and match IDs.
current_match_summary.sql: SELECT m.match_id, m.tournament_id, m.round_number, m.status, m.scoring_locked, m.match_revision, m.scored_holes, m.current_hole, m.holes_remaining, m.running_result, m.result_winner, m.clinched, m.scorecard_complete, m.unresolved_mutations, m.authority_updated_at, m.updated_at FROM scoring_authority.matches AS m WHERE m.tournament_id = $1 AND m.match_id = $2 LIMIT 1

current_match_holes.description: Read the current hole-score projection for one exact tournament and match.
current_match_holes.sql: SELECT h.match_id, h.hole_number, h.hole_revision, h.team_1_net_score, h.team_2_net_score, h.hole_winner, h.updated_at FROM scoring_authority.hole_scores AS h JOIN scoring_authority.matches AS m ON m.match_id = h.match_id WHERE m.tournament_id = $1 AND h.match_id = $2 ORDER BY h.hole_number ASC LIMIT 18

current_ingress_authority.description: Read the current ingress authority for one exact tournament.
current_ingress_authority.sql: SELECT g.tournament_id, g.state, g.authority, g.active_epoch_id, g.unresolved_client_queues, g.updated_at FROM scoring_authority.ingress_gates AS g WHERE g.tournament_id = $1 LIMIT 1
